criteria.evidence: Response explicitly recommends creating a 'dedicated read-only role/user scoped to just what the agent needs' instead of admin credentials, directly applying least privilege.
Flags admin credentials as 'a significant security risk' and explains blast radius, arguing against using unnecessary (admin) privilege for a read-only task.

Provides concrete SQL examples (GRANT SELECT only) and suggests restricting the tool to only execute SELECT statements via app-layer allowlist, restricting authorization to the minimum required (read access).
criteria.criterion: Restrict the tool to the minimum required authorization.
